answers.moment: When Tomasz told me his dad was a welder in a shipyard in Gdańsk in the eighties - not the famous one, but near it. He said 'He was not a hero. He went to work and he came home.' Really matter-of-fact about it, but you could tell he was proud. I hadn't expected that connection at all
answers.reason: It's basically what I tell my Year 10s - living history
